system.summary: Invented-sign substitution for Italian with a few homophones (three E forms, two A forms), a sign for CHE, and a numbered nomenclator written with figures (48, 4θ, 4r) and letter groups (rr, qq, peu).
system.notes: Bare Lambda is a doubling mark; the far-sign is CHE or NTO; theta is D and G; q is H (and F in fr. 3096). Same cipher as visconti1528.

texts.label: Letter 1: BnF fr. 3045 f. 28 (R4230), Galeazzo Visconti to Angelo Bolano, Alessandria, 15 Oct 1528
texts.summary: Visconti to Angelo Bolano: the only news is that Savona has been relieved, 'for the slowness of the world'; divisions have cost the command its reputation, 'like a lost battle, everyone wanted to go into winter quarters', the adventurer infantry have left for want of pay, the advance money is 'in Puglia' with the wreck of Lautrec's army, and the lances are few and late.

reading_review.note: Verify v8, 23 Oct 2026: the sweep's 0.59 scored fr3045_f28_reading.md, the line-by-line first pass. Running text rewritten with the push-pass readings of fr3045_f28_final.md, as the 22 Oct review asked (fr3045_f28_v2_reading.md): 0.778 on explicit holes (14/18), 0.278 plain (the word list does not know 1528 Lombard spelling), hole rate 0.111. Marginal: Savona relieved, the loss of reputation 'come batale perduta', the adventurers gone for want of pay, the money in Puglia, the few late lances and the close build sentences; ll. 8-9 ('et pur al tuto ... cum Urbino'), the 'quanto ci è' clause and ll. 14-15 ('Designati ... as[?]sedio') do not. Codes [42] [rr] [qq] [ep] have no key.

texts.label: Letter 2: BnF fr. 3096 f. 91r (R4256), Galeazzo Visconti to Francis I, camp at the pieve de Locate, 15 June 1529
texts.summary: Visconti to Francis I: knowing the Venetians' fear of a peace, above all of being bound against the Turk, he assured the Duke of Urbino and the provveditore that the King will never abandon the Signoria, and said as much of the Duke of Milan; the council's plan to try to force Milan will fail, 'et il tuto, Sire, è a uno fine non bono'. In clear he begs to be paid his two quarters.
